description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case, used across the application's UI for consistent rendering.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and multiple whitespace, returning the original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display, handling delimiters, apostrophes, accented characters, and preserving original value if not a string.
